name: farplane-ui
description: Farplane - single-brain, multi-hand AI operating system

scripts.typecheck:all: pnpm run typecheck:root && pnpm run ui:typecheck
scripts.lint: biome lint --diagnostic-level=error --files-ignore-unknown=true --skip=style --skip=complexity --skip=a11y --skip=correctness/noUnusedImports --skip=correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies --skip=correctness/useHookAtTopLevel --skip=suspicious/noArrayIndexKey biome.json package.json cli/team-commands convex extensions/notion skills ui/src/components/hud ui/src/modules/hook-telemetry ui/src/modules/team-workspace ui/src/lib
scripts.lint:fix: biome lint --write --diagnostic-level=error --files-ignore-unknown=true --skip=style --skip=complexity --skip=a11y --skip=correctness/noUnusedImports --skip=correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies --skip=correctness/useHookAtTopLevel --skip=suspicious/noArrayIndexKey biome.json package.json cli/team-commands convex extensions/notion skills ui/src/components/hud ui/src/modules/hook-telemetry ui/src/modules/team-workspace ui/src/lib
scripts.format: biome format --write --files-ignore-unknown=true biome.json package.json cli/team-commands convex extensions/notion skills ui/src/components/hud ui/src/modules/hook-telemetry ui/src/modules/team-workspace ui/src/lib
scripts.format:check: biome check --files-ignore-unknown=true --linter-enabled=false --assist-enabled=false biome.json package.json cli/team-commands convex extensions/notion skills ui/src/components/hud ui/src/modules/hook-telemetry ui/src/modules/team-workspace ui/src/lib
scripts.youtube:serve: concurrently -k -n codex,bridge "sh -c 'if lsof -nP -iTCP:47892 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null; then echo Reusing existing Codex app-server; while lsof -nP -iTCP:47892 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null; do sleep 10; done; else exec codex app-server --listen ws://127.0.0.1:47892; fi'" "pnpm youtube:agent"
